{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check duplicate patient_ids
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

print("\nArm vs Severity cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
